title: Hardware Engineering Technical Leader - Power Engineer (Hybrid)
locations: Austin, Texas, United States of America
teaser: We are looking for a Hardware Engineering Technical Leader - Power Engineer to develop high-reliability power supplies and system-level power architectures for Cisco’s power distribution platforms. Lead the design and qualification of power systems, collaborating with cross-functional teams. Ideal for experienced power design engineers with a strong background in DC-powered equipment.
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 10/30/2026
Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

This is a hybrid role with three days per week at Cisco’s Austin office 

Meet the Team

The Cisco Common Hardware Group (CHG) is growing its next-generation power engineering team. You'll join industry-leading innovators in the field of Fault Managed Power (FMP) to redefine how DC power is distributed in buildings and datacenters in the AI era. Because full product development—from design to qualification to production—is within our team, we’re able to think differently, experiment more, and work quickly. Join us to power the future of the digital world.

Your Impact

Develop high reliability power supplies and system-level power architectures for Cisco power distribution platforms.

Architect, design, develop, and qualify power systems, subsystems, and components for highly reliable power distribution systems.

Partner with layout, mechanical, thermal, test, supply chain, manufacturing, and compliance teams to deliver best-in-class power solutions.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelors + 12 years of related experience, or Masters + 8 years of related experience, or PhD + 5 years of related experience.

Experience working as a power design engineer for high-reliability power supplies for DC-powered equipment.

Proven experience with all aspects of power product lifecycle from early product definition all the way through shipping products to customers, and everything in between.

Experience with resolving EMI, EMC, and regulatory compliance issues.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with high-density, redundant AC and also DC input front-end power supplies for networking and telecom equipment.

Experience with 480V/277V HVAC and 200V-400V HVDC input supplies

Experience with digital circuit fault detection and mitigation technologies such as solid--state overcurrent protection, arc fault detection, or ground fault detection.

Experience meeting Functional Safety requirements from standards such as IEC 61508 or similar as well as product safety standards such as IEC 62368 or UL 1400-1

Experience with Cadence Schematic and PCB design tools

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
